lit.\u0027\u003cdiv class=\"tools\"\u003e\u0:
"
"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAquí el electrón salt:
"

Here the electron jumps from one orbital to another on absorbing energy from the flame and returns that energy as a photon of definite wavelength.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCon el collarín de ai:
"

With the air collar closed the flame is reducing and yellow (soot) and masks weak colors. Open, it is oxidizing and blue, with almost no light of its own: ideal for the test.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl asa de platino lle:
"

The platinum loop carries LiCl into the flame: the heat excites electrons of Li⁺ and, on returning to the ground level, they emit red light (670.8 nm).

Try other salts in the left panel.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl sodio emite el \u0:
"

Sodium emits the D doublet near 589 nm: very intense yellow. The bar below shows where each line falls in the visible spectrum.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl sodio ensucia casi:
"

Sodium contaminates almost any sample with its yellow. Cobalt glass absorbs it and lets the violet of potassium show: that is how K⁺ is distinguished even when traces of Na⁺ are present.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el diagrama de \u0:
"

In the Grotrian diagram the arrow goes from the excited level to the ground level; its energy ΔE = hc/λ sets the color. In the Orbital tab you will see the excitation → emission cycle.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEntre muestras se sum:
"

Between samples the loop is dipped in HCl and heated until the flame returns to the base blue. Otherwise, residual sodium gives false positives.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eObserva el color de l:
"

Observe the flame color, the measured wavelength and the spectrum lines. The data that reveal the name are hidden.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe elige una sal al a:
"

A salt is chosen at random and its name is hidden. Observe the flame color, the wavelength and the spectrum, and decide which cation it is.

"
lit.\u0027Cada catión colorea la llama de fo: "Each cation colors the flame in a characteristic way"
lit.\u0027Diagrama de niveles: la transición: "Level diagram: the transition explains the color"
lit.\u0027Elige una sal en el panel izquierd: "Choose a salt in the left panel and insert the loop into the flame. Drag to rotate the scene and use the wheel to zoom. The guided lesson (book, key L) walks through the concepts; Unknown sample asks you to identify the cation."
lit.\u0027Grotrian: niveles y transición; Or: "Grotrian: levels and transition; Orbital: excitation → emission cycle."
lit.\u0027Identifica el catión a partir de l: "Identify the cation from the wavelength, the color and the spectrum."
lit.\u0027La llama es una línea (o un doblet: "The flame is a line (or a doublet) of the spectrum"
lit.\u0027Muestra desconocida \u003cspan cla: "Unknown sample salt?"
lit.\u0027Ocultar los paneles para ver toda: 'Hide the panels to see the whole simulation (O)'
lit.\u0027toca su título para contraerlos; e: "tap their title to collapse them; the eye (key O) hides them all to see the whole flame."
lit.\u0027ubica las líneas del analito entre: "places the analyte lines between 380 and 750 nm."
